places.normalized: Six Jolly Fellowship Porters, Limehouse, London
places.quote: Show the Force the Six Jolly Fellowship Porters, and the Force—to a constable—will show you a piece of perfection
places.note: Fictional public house in Our Mutual Friend, located in Limehouse; the Inspector's conversation takes place there.

places.quote: When they reached London in pursuance of their little plan, they took coach and drove westward.
